recognize_zh: 低倍下周邊血液淋巴球明顯增多，細胞中小型、大小相當一致，核圓或略不規則，胞質少量且偏深藍，部分有小突起，並散在幾個塗抹細胞（smudge cells）；單調的嗜鹼性胞質淋巴球增多是 T-PLL 的低倍印象，細節需高倍與流式確認。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of fairly monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin
Scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with small cytoplasmic blebs
Nucleoli and nuclear contour detail not reliably assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of fairly monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic blebs. Occasional smudge cells are present, and red cells appear unremarkable. Nucleoli and nuclear irregularities cannot be reliably evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a mature T-cell leukemia such as T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, which requires flow cytometric and cytogenetic (TCL1A) confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with clumped soccer-ball chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm, and are CD5/CD23-positive B cells, whereas T-PLL is a TCL1A-rearranged T-cell leukemia.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a modest count, rather than scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei and similar size but are CD5+ B cells with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
